findings.title: Guard adapter loading with the exit-2 error boundary
findings.body: During an incomplete or concurrent skill installation, the runner can exist before its new sibling module is available. Loading that module raises `FileNotFoundError` or `PermissionError` before `entry()` can catch it, so Python exits 1 without recording findings. I reproduced exit 1 with the sibling absent, even for `--help`. Move adapter loading inside the protected startup path so this failure returns 2.
